items.title: 10.2 Oxidation number aur us ki ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.2, printed page 214.

blocks.title: Oxidation number
blocks.text: Oxidation numbers, jinhen oxidation states bhi kehte hain, compound mein har atom ya ion ko diye gaye woh numbers hain jo us ke oxidation ka darja dikhate hain. Yeh musbat, manfi ya sifar ho sakte hain, aur + ya - ka nishan hamesha shamil hona chahiye. Oxidation number molecule ya ion mein kisi element ke atom par (fi atom) zahiri charge hai.
Zyada musbat oxidation number ka matlab atom ya ion zyada oxidised hai; zyada manfi oxidation number ka matlab woh zyada reduced hai. Agle do topics usool aur hal shuda misalein dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Is ka kya matlab hai ke manganese KMnO4 mein +7 magar MnCl2 mein +2 hai?
blocks.explanation: Oxidation number fi atom zahiri charge hai. Permanganate mein manganese kahin zyada oxidised hai, us ne manganese(II) chloride ke muqable oxygen ko electron ka zyada hissa de rakha hai; +7 se +2 jana reduction hoga, fi manganese paanch electrons ka hasil hona.

items: Oxidation number (state): molecule ya ion mein fi atom zahiri charge, nishan ke saath; zyada musbat = zyada oxidised, zyada manfi = zyada reduced.
